name: laravel-best-practices
title_zh: 写 Laravel 时先问一句有没有 N+1 的老同
tagline_zh: 提交前自动扫控制器、模型、迁移、队列任务，专治 Eloquent 懒加载和缓存漏配。不打断你写码。
tagline_en: Auto-scans controllers, models, migrations, jobs for lazy-loading and missing cache before you commit. Flags.
desc_en: Apply this skill whenever writing, reviewing, or refactoring Laravel PHP code. This includes creating or modifying controllers, models, migrations, form requests, policies, jobs, scheduled commands, service classes, and Eloquent queries. Triggers for N+1 and query performance issues, caching strategies, authorization and security patterns, validation, error handling, queue and job configuration, r
why_zh: 它把 Laravel 官方最佳实践固化成可执行的规则集，按 diff 逐行审查。
why_en: Turns Laravel's official best practices into a diff-level rule engine, flagging exact lines instead of handing you a generic.
limit_zh: 只认 PHP 8.1+ 的 Laravel 10/11 项目；不处理前端 Blade 之外的 JS/TS。
limit_en: PHP 8.1+, Laravel 10/11 only. Ignores JS/TS outside Blade. Non-Eloquent query builder gets warnings, not auto-fixes. Outputs review comments, not.
title_en: A Laravel code reviewer that sniffs out N+1 first
